label: Phase 008: the lifted matcher carries a cost model (BUILD_COST 8, scan until building pays) and a hard MAX_SECRET_MATCHER_STATES cap of 1,000,000 with a per-value fallback; the plan lift line states neither and a reimplementation can exhaust memory.

Phase 008: the matcher returns merged ranges where overlapping matches make one stretch, which is what stops a redactor leaving the tail of a longer secret behind; the plan leak-checks doc names no overlap rule.

Phase 008: the placeholder guard holds the known dev and example values and throws when a non-dev environment still carries one; the plan bots secret set refuses nothing on the value content, so a placeholder can be recorded as a set secret.

Phase 008: the reference grants a secret to a set of bots (VaultBots allBots plus botIds) while the plan grants a bot a list of secrets; only the reference direction gives a new bot nothing by default, and an allBots flag is the cheap addition.

Phase 008: the reference never surfaces the secret store own error, only one of three fixed refusals, because other errors could echo the value; the plan covers redaction of a known value but not an unknown error carrying it.
